description: Capacity measured at the previous (already completed) RPT visit. NaPINN-Q initial state u_current.
Previous-RPT capacity relative to the cell's first valid RPT. Encodes initial_rpt_Q_Ah given previous_rpt_Q_Ah, so the baseline capacity is not registered separately.
Cumulative equivalent full cycles at the anchor. Canonical stress coordinate; cumulative_Ah_throughput is a scalar multiple and is deliberately not registered.
Nominal depth of discharge of the block.
Nominal charge C-rate of the block.
Nominal discharge C-rate of the block.
Nominal chamber temperature of the block.
Zero-based index of the current cycling block for this cell. Copy of the ``visit`` identity column, registered under a distinct name so identity and feature namespaces never collide.
Discharge capacity of the anchor cycle.
Q_discharge / Q_charge of the anchor cycle. Makes Q_charge_Ah and capacity_throughput_ratio redundant.
E_charge_Wh - E_discharge_Wh at the anchor cycle.
mean_charge_voltage - mean_discharge_voltage, each computed as E/Q with safe division.
Maximum measured cell temperature during the anchor cycle.
T_max - T_min at the anchor cycle.
Robust backward slope of discharge capacity over the trailing 10 cycles.
Backward rolling standard deviation of discharge capacity, 10 cycles.
Anchor-cycle discharge capacity minus its trailing 10-cycle mean.
Backward rolling mean coulombic efficiency, 10 cycles.
Robust backward slope of coulombic efficiency over 10 cycles. Gassing-sensitive.
log variance of Delta-Q(V) over the shared voltage grid (Severson).
Minimum of Delta-Q(V) over the shared voltage grid.
L2 norm of Delta-Q(V) over the shared voltage grid.
Skewness of the Delta-Q(V) distribution.
Voltage at which |Delta-Q(V)| is largest.
Width of the shared voltage interval used for Delta-Q(V).
Voltage shift of the first discharge dQ/dV peak relative to the first complete cycle of the same block.
Signed change in the first discharge dQ/dV peak height relative to the first complete cycle of the same block.
Temperature rise across the anchor cycle's discharge phase.
Maximum |dT/dt| during the anchor cycle.
Discharge temperature rise divided by discharged capacity.
Discharge-side DC internal resistance dV/dI at the previous RPT.
Previous-RPT DCIR minus the cell's first valid RPT DCIR.
1 / (T_degC + 273.15). No activation energy is assumed.
EFC_cum * (DOD_pct / 100).
EFC_cum * inverse_temperature_1_K.
EFC_cum * C_dis.
1 when Delta-Q(V) had a usable shared voltage interval.
1 when a reproducible first discharge dQ/dV peak was found in both the anchor and the block-reference cycle.
1 when the previous RPT contained a valid current step.
1 when at least MIN_TEMPORAL_OBSERVATIONS complete cycles precede the anchor within the block.
